app.name: Steam Game Picker
app.description: Sign in with Steam and pick a random game from your library to play.
app.footer: Not affiliated with Valve Corporation. Data provided by the Steam Web API.
app.loadErrorText: The server didn't respond. Check your connection and reload the page.

login.title: Don't know what to play?
login.text: Sign in with your Steam account. We read your library and pick a game for you.
login.failed: Couldn't confirm your Steam sign-in. Please try again.
login.note: Sign-in happens on the Steam website. Your password never passes through here; we only receive your public SteamID.

private.title: Your library is private
private.text: Steam only shows your games if your game details are public. On Steam, open Profile → Edit Profile → Privacy Settings and set Game details to Public.
private.retry: I've made it public, try again

steamDown.title: Steam didn't respond
steamDown.text: We couldn't fetch your library right now. This usually clears up in a few minutes.

empty.title: No games found
empty.text: Your account has no games in its library. Family Sharing games don't show up through the API.

library.noMatch: No game in your library matches this filter.
library.noMatchInCollection: No game in the "{name}" collection matches this filter.

import.title: Import Steam collections
import.intro: Steam doesn't expose collections through its API, but the client keeps a copy on your computer. Upload that file and we'll read your collections right here in the browser. Nothing is sent to the server.
import.windowsHint: If Steam was installed somewhere else, look for the Steam\userdata folder on that drive.
import.dynamicNote: Dynamic collections (created from filters) don't store their list of games, so they aren't imported.

errors.invalidJson: This file isn't valid JSON. Make sure you chose {file}.
errors.noCollections: No collections found. Make sure the file is the {file} from the right folder.

history.title: Picked games

summary.one: {count} pick this session. The list is cleared when you sign out.
summary.other: {count} picks this session. The list is cleared when you sign out.

history.emptyText: Games you pick show up here until you sign out.
